name: Karapinar, Konya
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -1.2 to -5.2 regional GNSS; > -7.0 in agricultural bowls
agreement_note: 108-day summer LOS peak (-5.9 cm, -8.0 cm vertical est.) exceeds multi-year annual rate due to summer pumping; independently supported by 29-sinkhole proximity contrast (-4.15 cm within 1 km vs -0.65 cm >5 km, permutation p=0.021). Valid fraction 14.5%, single reference.
press_summary_gate_note: Sinkhole proximity contrast (-4.15 vs -0.65 cm, p=0.021) approved with provisional caveat; do not cite -20.0 cm/yr as an annual permanent rate.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed NISAR Karapinar paper found as of 2026-11-14.
first_nisar_measurement.atlas_first_claim_note: Multi-basin standardized atlas phrasing must use qualified (to our knowledge) only after excluding Mexico City from any individual-first claim.
